title: Porn addiction, sharing water, secret son: Catch up on the day’s stories | CNN
text:
👋Welcome to 5 Things PM!Cervical cancer is one of the most preventable types, yet a growing number of American women have never been screened.A doctor explains the risks.

Here’s what else you might have missed during your busy day.

Like so many boys, Freddie Woodward was exposed to porn at an early age, but it spiraled into addiction and started to corrode different areas of his life. Now the Olympic diver wants to help otherswho are suffering in silence.

Chinese workers were building infrastructure in Nepal when disaster struck. Their families back home want to know what happened to them and wonder whether rescue effortsare reaching their loved ones.

▶️ Watch:CNN goes inside rescue operations in worst-hit area of Nepal

➕How to help flood victims

Vice President JD Vance has given voice to a rising skepticism toward Israel,leaving some Jewish Republicans uncomfortableabout the expected GOP frontrunner in the next presidential election.

🚨 Analysis:The light is blinking red on Trump messing with the 2026 election

A decades-long megadrought has significantly drained Lake Mead, the nation’s largest reservoir. Nearby states are reckoning withhow to share a shrinking water supply.

A car salesman just became a prince at the age of 26 after a DNA test confirmed his biological father — andthis isn’t the first secretinvolving Belgium’s Royal Family.

😱 Masked crime spree:Bodycam footage shows detectives in Lorton, Virginia, arresting a man who waswearing a mask from the “Scream” movies. The suspect is accused of causing thousands of dollars in damage to a community center.

🌼 In full bloom:Music, style and politics all were on display at Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields festival in Irvine, California.Check out the colorful highlights.

EDITOR’S NOTE:Interested in exclusive stories like these?Choose a plan

🪖 Dan Driscoll, pictured here, just resigned. He served as secretary of which branch of the US military?

A. Army

B. Navy

C. Air Force

D. Marine Corps

⬇️Scroll down for the answer.

✅Most popular in yesterday’s newsletter:Forget cheesesteaks. Philly has pigeon tours now

🧠Quiz answer: A.Driscoll stepped downfrom his Army postamid tensions with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.

👋 We’ll see you tomorrow.
